scripts.dev: npm run data:build && npm run dev --workspace site
scripts.build: npm run data:validate && npm run data:build && npm run build --workspace site
scripts.build:dev: npm run data:validate && npm run data:build:dev && npm run build --workspace site
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && node tools/deploy-pages.mjs --project gdr-site --assets site/dist --functions site/functions --branch main
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && node tools/deploy-pages.mjs --project gdr-site-dev --assets site/dist --functions site/functions --branch dev
scripts.deploy:survey: node tools/deploy-pages.mjs --project gdr-survey --assets survey --functions functions --branch main
scripts.deploy:admin: cd admin && npx --yes wrangler@4.165.0 pages deploy . --project-name gdr-admin --branch main --commit-dirty=true
